# Case Metadata

* **Style of Cause:** *`r params$case_name`*
* **Citation:** `r params$citation` (Docket No. `r params$docket_no`)
* **Court & Date:** `r params$court` (`r params$decision_date`)
* **Practice Area:** `r params$practice_area`

```{r csl, echo=F, warning=F, message=F }
library(readr)

scc_data <- read_csv(
  "scc_meta-data_1975-2021.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
scc_data$title <- enc2utf8(scc_data$title)
scc <- function(id, bibfile = "citation.bib", append = TRUE) {
  id <- tolower(trimws(id))
  case <- scc_data[tolower(scc_data$id) == id, ]

  if (nrow(case) == 0) {
    stop("No SCC decision found for ID: ", id)
  }

  if (nrow(case) > 1) {
    stop("More than one decision matched ID: ", id)
  }

  key <- paste0("scc", id)
  canlii_url <- sprintf(
    "https://www.canlii.org/en/ca/scc/doc/%s/%s/%s.html",
    case$year, id, id
  )

entry <- paste0(
  "@jurisdiction{", key, ",\n",
  "  title        = {{", enc2utf8(case$title), "}},\n",
  "  author       = {{Supreme Court of Canada}},\n",
  "  note         = {", case$citation, "},\n",
  "  number       = {", case$docketNumber, "},\n",
  "  url          = {", canlii_url, "},\n",
  "  urldate      = {", Sys.Date(), "}\n",
  "}\n"
)

  if (append) {
    if (file.exists(bibfile) &&
        grepl(paste0("@\\w+\\{", key, ","), readChar(bibfile, file.info(bibfile)$size))) {
      message("Entry already exists in ", bibfile, ": ", key)
    } else {
      cat("\n", entry, file = bibfile, append = TRUE)
      message("Added ", key, " to ", bibfile)
    }
  }

  invisible(entry)
}
```

```{r citation generator, echo=F, warning=F, message=F}
scc("1989canlii133")
```

# Executive Summary & Holding

State the core legal holding in two to three sentences. Summarize the
practical impact on existing jurisprudence or client strategy.

# Factual & Procedural Background

* **Key Facts:** Outline the material facts that triggered the dispute.
* **Procedural History:** Summarize lower court rulings and how the matter
  reached the appellate or reviewing court.

# Legal Issues

1. **Primary Issue:** Frame the central question of law as a neutral
   *Whether...* statement.
2. **Secondary Issue:** State any ancillary statutory or evidentiary
   questions.

# Court's Reasoning & Analysis

* **Majority Opinion:** Detail the statutory interpretation, standard of
  review, and precedent applied by the majority.
* **Concurring / Dissenting Opinions:** Note key doctrinal disagreements or
  alternative frameworks raised on the bench.

"as seen in *General Motors*[@scc1989canlii133] $...$"


# Commentary & Practice Implications

* **Doctrinal Significance:** Evaluate whether the decision narrows,
  expands, or overturns prior case law.
* **Strategic Recommendations:** List concrete compliance steps, contract
  drafting updates, or litigation risks for clients.
